data.name: Kumara (Podi) – Car
data.description:
Visit Sri Lanka and get a driver for hire. Sri Lanka is amazing tropical country in the world. **SNC Kumara** (**Podi)** is a well-knowledge professional tourist driver. He loves his role in Sri Lanka tourism and he always available to explore Sri Lanka with tourists around the world. Hire a personal driver with private car for your trip and enjoy the tour. He undertakes Round Tours, Sightseeing Tours, Day Excursions, Culture and Heritage Tours, and Wildlife Safari Tours.

##### **More Info:**

Type of Vehicle : Honda Fit Shuttle Car

Years of Experience: 10 Years

Language(s) : English

To book use one of easy option for you as mentioned below:

- Fill out the booking form
- Send an email to**[info@srilankatoursdriver.com](mailto:info@srilankatoursdriver.com)**
- Send WhatsApp message to **[(+94) 769 300 334](https://wa.me/+94769300334)**

---

#### **Payment conditions per day tour vehicles & Important needs to be done as follows:**

- **You can make the full payment on the first day at once as we mentioned.**
- **As the 2nd option, payment can be made daily based on the extra mileage. (From the pickup location, we set the mileage of the vehicle to 0 (zero), and at the end of the day, you have to pay according to the mileage that you have covered during the day.)**
- **A minimum of 3 days need to be booked at least.**
- **Per Day 170km. if you use more than 170 km,need to pay extra Mileage

Car Per 1Km=100LKR

Van Per 1Km=150LKR

Bus Per 1Km=190LKR.**

- **When you booking through the booking form, default start time and end time is 00:00 hours.**
- **If you want to use the car & driver all day long in last day, please select end time as 23:00 hours.**
